title: Dhwani TTS Live Update
short_msg: New Indian voices & HD speed boost are now live! Double tap to view full details.
full_msg:
Welcome to Dhwani TTS v1.7.0 by Interested Technology for Blind!

Go to the Voice Library tab to download and test the new voices!
update_notes: Version 1.7.0 is available with all Indian voices, anti-stutter phoneme support, and HD audio boost.
